-- Billing Engine Tables (Wave 115)

DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'pricing_model') THEN
    CREATE TYPE pricing_model AS ENUM ('per_transaction', 'subscription', 'hybrid');
  END IF;
END $$;

DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'billing_config_status') THEN
    CREATE TYPE billing_config_status AS ENUM ('draft', 'active', 'superseded', 'archived');
  END IF;
END $$;

DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'overhead_cost_category') THEN
    CREATE TYPE overhead_cost_category AS ENUM ('infrastructure', 'labor', 'travel', 'marketing', 'compliance', 'support', 'other');
  END IF;
END $$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS billing_configs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  status billing_config_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  pricing_model pricing_model NOT NULL DEFAULT 'per_transaction',
  fee_rate REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.015,
  fee_cap_kobo BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 200000,
  fee_floor_kobo BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  platform_share REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.65,
  reseller_share REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.35,
  interchange_cost_kobo BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 5000,
  sign_on_fee_kobo BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  sign_on_platform_share REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.70,
  subscription_fee_kobo BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  subscription_platform_share REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.65,
  tb_merchant_payable_account TEXT,
  tb_platform_revenue_account TEXT,
  tb_reseller_payable_account TEXT,
  tb_interchange_cost_account TEXT,
  tb_sign_on_revenue_account TEXT,
  monthly_overhead_cap_kobo BIGINT DEFAULT 0,
  effective_from TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  effective_to TIMESTAMP,
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  approved_by TEXT,
  approved_at TIMESTAMP,
  notes TEXT,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS billing_config_tenant_idx ON billing_configs(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS billing_config_active_idx ON billing_configs(tenant_id, active);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS billing_audit_log (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  billing_config_id TEXT REFERENCES billing_configs(id),
  actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_role TEXT NOT NULL,
  action TEXT NOT NULL,
  before_state JSONB,
  after_state JSONB,
  reason TEXT,
  ip_address TEXT,
  user_agent TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS billing_audit_tenant_idx ON billing_audit_log(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS billing_audit_actor_idx ON billing_audit_log(actor_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS billing_audit_config_idx ON billing_audit_log(billing_config_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS overhead_costs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  category overhead_cost_category NOT NULL,
  amount_kobo BIGINT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  period_start TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  period_end TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  recorded_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS overhead_tenant_idx ON overhead_costs(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS overhead_period_idx ON overhead_costs(tenant_id, period_start, period_end);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS overhead_category_idx ON overhead_costs(tenant_id, category);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS billing_events (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  reseller_id TEXT,
  transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  amount_kobo BIGINT NOT NULL,
  gross_fee_kobo BIGINT NOT NULL,
  platform_revenue_kobo BIGINT NOT NULL,
  reseller_revenue_kobo BIGINT NOT NULL,
  interchange_cost_kobo BIGINT NOT NULL,
  net_platform_revenue_kobo BIGINT NOT NULL,
  pricing_model pricing_model NOT NULL,
  channel TEXT NOT NULL,
  currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NGN',
  occurred_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS billing_event_tenant_idx ON billing_events(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS billing_event_merchant_idx ON billing_events(merchant_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS billing_event_occurred_idx ON billing_events(tenant_id, occurred_at);
